title: Feat: add preact compat tests
body:
### Changelog Entry

(No changelog entry for tests change)

## Description

This PR introduces a test suite to evaluate Preact compatibility with Web Chat. The motivation is two-fold:

1. As React increasingly focuses on server components and treats web as a compilation target, we need to explore alternatives that better align with Web Chat's platform-first approach
2. Preact offers several advantages that fit Web Chat's use cases:
   - Native custom elements support
   - Lighter bundle size
   - ESM build availability
   - React compatibility layer

While this PR doesn't commit to a Preact migration, it establishes groundwork for future architectural decisions based on how the React ecosystem evolves.

## Design

For now the only change needed was to add property setters to our custom elements to support Preact's property-first approach to unknown attributes (https://github.com/preactjs/preact/issues/4416 a way to denote either the attribute or property should be set from JSX is being discussed). The test suite verifies some Web Chat features under Preact:

- Activity feedback
- Custom elements
- Math layout
- Fluent theme compatibility

## Specific Changes

- Added property setters for `theme` and `language` in `CodeBlock` custom element to support Preact's attribute handling
- Created Preact compatibility test suite in `__tests__/html2/preact/` covering:
  - Activity feedback and view code button
  - Fluent theme integration
  - Custom element markdown handling
  - Math layout specifications
